what: A large curated toolkit for Claude Code: agents, skills, slash commands, plugins, hooks, rules, templates and MCP configs in one repo.
Graphify turns a codebase, plus its docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. It ships as a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.
install:
uv tool install graphifyy
graphify install

what: Beacon by Asymptote Labs captures session history across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ other harnesses and turns it into reusable knowledge.
note: Asymptote Labs raised $5.5M in a seed round led by Tower Research Ventures, announced Oct 20, 2026 (source).
install:
brew tap asymptote-labs/tap
brew install beacon

what: Cloudflare's official agent skills. They teach your coding agent how to build and deploy on Cloudflare, so it stops guessing at things like wrangler config. The plugin also adds Cloudflare's MCP server.
